method: Direct visual inspection of PDF assembly views and BOM; no coordinate extraction from drawing pixels.

sources.title: Front Pull Rod and Connector Welding Jigs Assembly

observations: Front corner assembly BOM identifies item 9 as QA1 XML4 LH rod end and item 10 as QA1 XMR4 RH rod end.
Welding jig assembly shows two SU-70110 tabs on SU-70111 connector, associated with front upper fore/aft tubes SU-70105/70106 and upper bearing housing SU-70103.
Connector detail dimensions describe the plate and tab slots; it does not supply a vehicle-frame ball-center coordinate.
limits: Views support attachment topology; they do not establish the numerical correspondence between COM SU116/117 and NSMA_PPAttPnt_L/R.
No global joint coordinates or assembly transforms are provided in the inspected drawings.
No clamp-stack mass ownership, spherical-bearing split, CG reassignment or dynamic inertia authority is inferred.
next_required_evidence: CAD arm-side front pullrod ball center or common tab-hole axis center, in the COM assembly configuration and vehicle frame; identify corresponding OptimumK reference.
